text.description_html:
First Impressions CB-YRK1008ACBAL, Modern Acrylic Cabinet Handle

The Modern Acrylic Cabinet Handle has an 8 inch overall length. It is great in kitchens, bathrooms, or even as a furniture pull. This acrylic cabinet pull is made from the highest quality clear acrylic. The mounts are finished in a modern brushed aluminum.

Specifications for the First Impressions CB-YRK1008ACBAL Modern Cabinet Pull:

  • Handle Material: Clear Acrylic
  • Bracket Material: Aluminum
  • Bracket Finish: Brushed Aluminum
  • Center to Center Mount: 5"
  • Width: 1"
  • Thickness: 5/8"
  • Clearance: 3/4"
  • Projection: 1-5/8"
  • Mounting: screws for a standard 3/4" thick cabinet door or drawer.

Note: This First Impressions acrylic pull is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.
